description: Sends a short use case (a job done with an agent that has no playbook yet), a lesson, or a correction to an existing playbook into the Agents Handbook review queue. Nothing is published until it is reviewed. Fields must not contain personal data.

body.description: What the agent did, how it went, what went wrong. No private data.

playbook.description: For a correction or lesson: the playbook slug.

title.description: The job as an imperative, for example 'Dispute a parking ticket with photos and the city rules'.

name: submit_use_case
title: Submit a use case
